subject.title: Feature Request: Anthropic Context Management Beta Passthrough

question: Should this issue remain the umbrella for Anthropic context-management design, or should maintainers split it into separate provider-native compaction, context editing, and Memory Tool/plugin-seam trackers?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the permanent public API/config shape and Memory Tool filesystem security boundary are product decisions that automation should not choose.

options.title: Split by boundary
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/10213 for provider-native compaction, keep this issue for shared Anthropic context-editing/API design, and keep Memory Tool work plugin-owned unless a core seam is missing.

options.title: Keep one umbrella
options.body: Use this issue as the single design item for compaction, context editing, beta payloads, and Memory Tool, accepting a broader and harder-to-review implementation path.

options.title: Replace with narrower trackers
options.body: Create or designate canonical items for each remaining slice, then close this umbrella only once no unique context remains.

recommendation.title: Split by boundary
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/10213 for provider-native compaction, keep this issue for shared Anthropic context-editing/API design, and keep Memory Tool work plugin-owned unless a core seam is missing.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest current-main history across the affected Anthropic/provider and compaction-policy surfaces.
